stage: frozen before target extraction and residual evaluation
source_check: Actually rehash once before reading; record size and mtime before/after. Same-version R001 coverage permits stop after all target samples are collected.
target_read: One bounded filtered pass per P/U1 sheet; decode force/deformation values only for the four X targets; do not extract/analyze Y histories or repeat the seven core tables. Stop once all four target grids and I/J endpoints are complete, row bound 200000 per sheet.
coverage: Use existing core-cache Base Reactions grids: SHW4X 0-59s/2951 samples; SHW7X 0-53.9s/2696 samples. Verify units kN/mm, no missing/duplicate/extra target ticks, exact I/J P duplication, mm/1000 to m, time/source-row order before predicting.
prediction: delta_d = fixed_a*(F-F0)+fixed_b*cumulative_trapezoid(sign(F)*abs(F)^(1/fixed_alpha)); F=P_I. Use each target's observed initial d0/F0, no fitted intercept/end correction or force sign flip.
residuals: Predict delta deformation conditional on each native force history, not forward structure response from earthquake input; residual=prediction-data. Retain every time and small/zero value. Report RMSE/MAE/max/bias/end in m and mm, RMSE divided by delta_d RMS, and full local residual files including failures. No binary success cutoff or model reselection.
event_identity: Only cross-case transfer checks; independence of earthquake input/event definitions not verified.
unknowns: Current database/endpoint mapping, LinkJointForce port and mass source remain separate. Good residuals do not prove true attributes, all 88 devices uniform, actual energy closure or control reduction rates.
input_files_policy: Complete four small target CSVs and residuals stay local for independent review; master explicitly decides Git whitelist. No NPZ or large raw upload.
